text: Acceptance amendment: passive recovery imports terminal scheduler/marker evidence as an attempt-scoped fact with exact cluster/job/submit-time and evidence digest. It performs an identity-checked ledger upsert if needed; a delayed failure for a superseded attempt is recorded historically and cannot overwrite the current retry. Recovery then retries only the bounded CAS workspace projection and journal import. Tests cover crash after ledger write/before workspace commit and a delayed failure racing a replacement attempt; both must yield one durable historical failure, a correct current attempt, and zero submission/retry/validation calls.
